decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - 2.          No development shall take place until full details of hard landscaping and protective fencing works have been submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority and these works shall be carried out as approved.  These details shall include existing and proposed finished ground levels, hard surfacing materials, and specification and positioning of fencing for tree protection.
(Reason.  To ensure a satisfactory appearance and to ensure protection from damage of the retained tree on site, in the interests of visual amenity).
description: Demolition of existing garage/store to provide an enlarged car park.
